items.answer: And God created man in his (own) image.
Your ways are not my ways.

items.prompt: וְעַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלַםִ וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה שִׁפְטוּ־נָא בֵּינִי וּבֵין כַּרְמִי
items.answer: And now, ye inhabitants of Jerusalem and ye men of Judah, judge, I pray you, between me and my vineyard.
And they hid the child and his nurse from the face of the queen.
Thy word is a lamp to my foot and a light to my path.
Make fat the heart of this people and make heavy their ears.
And the broad open places of the city shall be filled with boys and girls.

items.prompt: פני יהוה ברשעים להכרית מהארץ זכרם
items.answer: The face of Yahweh is against the wicked, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

data.pointed: פְּנֵי יְהוָה בָּרְשָׁעִים לְהַכְרִית מֵהָאָרֶץ זִכְרָם

items.note: verify the key's pointed text against the scan

items.answer: Thy silver and gold I do not delight in.

items.prompt: My way is hid (perf. fem.) from my God.
For all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
Their ways are not our ways.
And all the people bowed-down upon their knees before their king.
Let thine hand-maid speak in the ears of the king.
My God and my king reigns upon Zion his holy hill.
items.answer: מָלַךְ אֱלֹהַי וּמַלְכִּי עַל־צִיּוֹן הַר קָדְשׁוֹ

items.prompt: His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom (k. of eternity).
I will cut off their bow and all their weapons of warfare.
